info.title: Min Strøm Consumer API
info.summary: Read-only access to your own energy data with Min Strøm Plus.
info.description: Read your energy data with an API key created in the iOS app. An active Min Strøm Plus subscription is required. See the guides for time ranges, data interpretation, and request limits.

get.description: List your addresses and the data available for each.

200.description: Your addresses. The list is empty when no addresses are available.

get.description: Get electricity consumption. Hourly requests cover up to 366 days; daily, monthly, or yearly requests cover up to five years. Limits apply after range normalization.

200.description: Available readings in time order. Results may contain gaps or be empty.

get.description: Get electricity exported from solar. Hourly requests cover up to 366 days; daily, monthly, or yearly requests cover up to five years. Limits apply after range normalization.

200.description: Available readings in time order. Results may contain gaps or be empty.

get.description: Get calculated electricity costs, including VAT and fixed fees. Available for Danish addresses. Request up to 366 days after range normalization.

200.description: Available readings in time order. Results may contain gaps or be empty.

get.description: Get calculated solar-export revenue after fixed fees, excluding VAT. Available for Danish addresses. Request up to 366 days after range normalization.

200.description: Available readings in time order. Results may contain gaps or be empty.

get.description: Get confirmed electricity prices by hour or quarter-hour. Request up to 366 days at hourly resolution or 90 days at quarter-hour resolution, after range normalization.

200.description: Available readings in time order. Results may contain gaps or be empty.

get.description: Get upcoming hourly price estimates for DK1, DK2, SE3, and SE4. Forecasts follow the latest confirmed price, starting no earlier than the current hour. The available forecast period varies.

200.description: Available readings in time order. Results may contain gaps or be empty.

ConsumerBearer.description: API key created in the iOS app. Requires an active Min Strøm Plus subscription.

Timestamp.description: UTC instant encoded with Z. Interval ends are exclusive.

TimeZone.description: Calendar used for interval boundaries: Europe/Copenhagen. Timestamps are UTC.

Currency.description: Currency for monetary amounts and per-kWh rates.

id.description: Address ID to use in series requests.

region.description: Electricity-price region, or null when unavailable.

gridOperatorName.description: Grid operator name, or null when unavailable.

supplierName.description: Current electricity supplier name, or null when unavailable.

energyKWh.description: Returned energy in kWh. Missing rows are not zero.

isEstimate.description: True when the reading is estimated.

totalPricePerKWh.description: Effective rate in currency/kWh: (totalCost - fixedFeesForInterval) / energyKWh. Null at zero energy.

totalCost.description: Calculated consumption cost including fixed fees and VAT.

totalPricePerKWh.description: Effective rate in currency/kWh: (netRevenue + fixedFeesForInterval) / energyKWh. Null at zero energy.

netRevenue.description: Calculated net revenue after fixed fees, excluding VAT. May be negative.

totalPricePerKWh.description: Price in currency/kWh including VAT, rounded to three decimals. Based on available price components. Fixed fees are reported by the cost and revenue endpoints.

variableChargesPerKWh.description: Variable charges in currency/kWh including VAT, rounded to three decimals. Null when unavailable.

reason.description: Safe human-readable explanation; use errorCode for program logic.

data.description: Ascending sparse rows; empty is valid. Gaps are not zero readings.

AddressId.name: addressId
AddressId.description: Address ID returned by List addresses.

From.name: from
From.description: Inclusive RFC 3339 start with Z or numeric offset. Fractions accepted. Expanded outward to the interval.

To.name: to
To.description: Exclusive RFC 3339 end after from. Expands outward unless aligned. Caps apply after expansion.

Resolution.name: resolution
Resolution.description: Confirmed historical price resolution. Hour has a 366-day cap; fifteenMinutes has 90 days after normalization.

RequestId.description: Response UUID for support. Never send your key.

RetryAfter.description: Seconds until the latest reset among exhausted windows; present on 429.

LimitMinute.description: Configured minute limit; present after quota evaluation.

RemainingMinute.description: Remaining minute attempts; present after quota evaluation.

ResetMinute.description: Minute reset as Unix seconds (UTC fixed window); present after quota evaluation.

LimitDay.description: Configured day limit; present after quota evaluation.

RemainingDay.description: Remaining day attempts; present after quota evaluation.

ResetDay.description: Day reset as Unix seconds (UTC fixed window); present after quota evaluation.

BadRequest.description: Check the parameters and requested range: invalid_parameter, invalid_range, or range_too_large.

Unauthorized.description: The API key is invalid (invalid_token) or expired (credential_expired).

Forbidden.description: An active Plus subscription is required (plus_required), or access is denied (forbidden).

example.reason: An active Min Strøm Plus subscription is required.

NotFound.description: The address could not be found. Use an ID returned by List addresses.

UnavailableFeature.description: This data is unavailable for the address. Check its capability flags.

example.reason: This feature is unavailable for this address.

RateLimited.description: Minute or daily quota exhausted. Denied attempts count too; honor Retry-After.

example.reason: The request limit has been exceeded.

InternalError.description: An unexpected error occurred. Retry later or contact support.

UpstreamUnavailable.description: Data is temporarily unavailable. Retry later.

example.reason: The data provider is temporarily unavailable.

ServiceUnavailable.description: Subscription verification or request limiting is temporarily unavailable. Retry later.

example.reason: Min Strøm Plus subscription verification is unavailable.
